11:1: Alif Lam Ra. This is a Book whose verses have been made decisive, then explained from the presence of One Wise, All-Aware.
11:2: Do not serve anyone other than Allah. Surely I am to you from Him a warner and a bringer of glad tidings.
11:3: And ask forgiveness of your Rabb, then repent to Him, so that He may grant you good enjoyment until an appointed term, and give to every possessor of virtue his virtue. And if you turn away, then indeed I fear for you the punishment of a great Day.
11:4: Your return is to Allah, and He is capable of all things.
11:5: Beware! They fold their breasts to conceal from Him. Beware! Even when they cover themselves with their garments, He knows what they conceal and what they disclose. Surely He is Knower of the essence of the breasts.
11:6: There is no living creature on the earth but its provision belongs to Allah, and He knows its dwelling place and its place of entrustment; all is in a clear book.
11:7: And it is He who created the heavens and the earth in six days, and His Arsh was upon the water, that He might test you as to which of you is better in deed. And if you say: 'You will be resurrected after death,' surely those who disbelieve say: 'This is nothing but clear magic.'
11:8: And if We defer the punishment from them until a counted community, they surely say: 'What holds it back?' Beware! The day it comes to them, it will not be turned away from them, and that which they used to mock has surrounded them.
11:9: And if We let man taste mercy from Us, then strip it away from him, he surely becomes a hopeless ungrateful one.
11:10: And if We let him taste favor after a harm that touched him, he surely says: 'The evils have gone from me.' Surely he is exultant, boastful.
11:11: Except those who are patient and do righteous deeds; for them there is forgiveness and a great reward.
11:12: Perhaps you are abandoning a part of what is revealed to you, and your breast is constricted by it because of their saying: 'Why has not a treasure been sent down to him, or an angel come with him?' You are only a warner; and Allah is Trustee over all things.
11:13: Or do they say, 'He fabricated it'? Say: 'Then bring ten fabricated surahs like it, and call upon whomever you are able other than Allah, if you are truthful.'
11:14: If they do not answer you, then know that it has been sent down only with Allah's knowledge and that there is no god but Him; will you then be Muslims?
11:15: Whoever desires the worldly life and its adornment, We repay them their deeds fully therein, and they will not be diminished therein.
11:16: Those are the ones for whom there is nothing in the Hereafter but the Fire. What they did therein has come to nothing, and what they used to do is void.
11:17: Is [he] like the one who is upon a clear proof from his Rabb, and whom a witness from Him follows, and before it the Book of Moses was a leader and a mercy?
11:18: And who is more unjust than one who invents a lie against Allah? Those will be presented before their Rabb, and the witnesses will say: "These are the ones who lied against their Rabb." Beware! The curse of Allah is upon the wrongdoers.
11:19: They are the ones who turn away from the path of Allah and make it crooked, and they are the ones who disbelieve in the Hereafter.
11:20: Those could not incapacitate [Him] on the earth, and there were no protectors for them besides Allah. The punishment is multiplied for them. They could not hear and they could not see.
11:21: Those are the ones who have lost themselves, and what they fabricated has departed from them.
11:22: Undoubtedly, they in the Hereafter are the greatest losers.
11:23: Surely those who believe, do righteous deeds, and submit with all their heart to their Rabb, those are the companions of Paradise; they will abide eternally therein.
11:24: The example of the two groups is like the blind and the deaf, and the seeing and the hearing. Are the two equal in example? Will you not still reflect?
11:25: And indeed, We sent Noah to his people: 'Surely I am a clear warner for you.'
11:26: Do not serve anyone other than Allah, for I fear for you the punishment of a painful day.
11:27: The notables who disbelieved from his people said: "We see you only as a human being like ourselves, and we see following you only the lowest among us, thoughtlessly.
11:28: He said: 'O my people! Do you see: if I am upon a clear proof from my Rabb, and He has given me a mercy from Himself, and it has been obscured to you, shall we force it upon you while you dislike it?'
11:29: And O my people, I do not ask you for any wealth for it. My reward belongs only to Allah. And I am not one to drive away those who believe. Surely they will meet their Rabb. But I see you as an ignorant people.
11:30: And O my people! Who will help me against Allah if I drive them away? Will you not reflect at all?
11:31: And I do not say to you, 'With me are the treasures of Allah,' nor do I know the unseen, nor do I say, 'Indeed, I am an angel.' Nor do I say about those whom your eyes look down upon that Allah will never give them any good. Allah knows best what is within their souls. Indeed, I would then be of the wrongdoers.
11:32: They said: 'O Noah! You have disputed with us and prolonged our dispute. Bring us that which you promise us, if you are of the truthful.'
11:33: He said: "Only Allah will bring it to you if He wills, and you are not ones who can escape."
11:34: And my advice will not benefit you, even if I wished to advise you, if Allah intends to let you go astray. He is your Rabb, and to Him you will be returned.
11:35: Or do they say, 'He fabricated it'? Say: 'If I fabricated it, my crime is upon me, and I am free of the crimes you commit.'
11:36: And it was revealed to Noah: 'None of your people will ever believe except those who have already believed; so do not grieve over what they have been doing.
11:37: And build the ship before Our eyes and with Our revelation, and do not address Me concerning those who wronged; surely they will be drowned.
11:38: And he was building the ship. Whenever notables from his people passed by him, they ridiculed him. He said: 'If you ridicule us, then surely we will ridicule you just as you ridicule.
11:39: So soon you will know to whom will come a humiliating punishment, and upon whom will descend an enduring punishment.
11:40: Finally, when Our command came and the oven began to boil, We said: 'Load into it from every kind two pairs, and your family—except the one against whom the word has already gone forth—and those who believe.' And none believed with him except very few.
11:41: And he said: 'Embark on it. Its sailing and its stopping are with the name of Allah. Indeed, my Rabb is surely Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.'
11:42: And it was sailing with them amid waves like mountains. Noah called out to his son who was in a separate place: 'O my son! Embark with us.
11:43: He said: 'I will take refuge on a mountain that will protect me from the water.' He said: 'Today there is no protector from the command of Allah, except the one upon whom He has mercy.' And the wave came between them, and he was among the drowned.
11:44: And it was said: 'O earth, swallow your water! O sky, withhold!' And the water subsided, and the matter was decreed, and the ship settled upon Judi. And it was said: 'Away with the wrongdoing people!'
11:45: Noah called out to his Rabb and said: 'My Rabb, indeed my son is of my family, and indeed Your promise is true. You are the best of those who judge.'
11:46: He said: 'O Noah, indeed he is not of your family. Indeed, it is a deed not righteous. So do not ask of Me that of which you have no knowledge.
11:47: He said: 'My Rabb, indeed I seek refuge in You from asking You that of which I have no knowledge. And unless You forgive me and have mercy on me, I will be among the losers.'
11:48: It was said: 'O Noah, descend with peace from Us and with blessings upon you and upon the communities that are with you; and there are communities whom We will soon grant enjoyment, then a painful punishment from Us will touch them.
11:49: These are from the news of the unseen that We reveal to you. Neither you nor your people knew it before this. So be patient. Indeed, the outcome is for the possessors of taqwa.
11:50: And to the people of Ad, their brother Hud said: 'O my people, worship Allah. There is no deity for you other than Him. You are only inventors of lies.'
11:51: 'O my people, I do not ask of you a reward for it. My reward belongs only to the One who created me. Will you still not use reason?'
11:52: 'And O my people, ask forgiveness of your Rabb, then repent to Him so that He may send abundant rain from the sky upon you and add strength to your strength, and do not turn away as sinners.'
11:53: They said: 'O Hud, you did not bring us a clear proof, and we are not going to leave our deities upon your word, and we are not believers in you.
11:54: 'We only say that some of our deities have touched you with evil.' He said: 'Indeed, I call Allah to witness, and you bear witness that I am free from what you associate as partners,
11:55: Other than Him. So plot against me, all of you, then do not give me respite.
11:56: Indeed, I have put my trust in Allah, who is my Rabb and your Rabb. There is no living creature but that He holds it by its forelock. Indeed, my Rabb is on a straight path.
11:57: If you turn away, indeed I have conveyed to you that with which I was sent to you. My Rabb will replace you with another people, and you cannot harm Him with anything. Indeed, my Rabb is the Preserver of all things.'
11:58: When Our command came, We saved Hud and those who believed with him by a mercy from Us, and We saved them from a severe punishment.
11:59: Such was the people of Ad! They denied the verses of their Rabb, rebelled against His messengers, and followed the command of every obstinate tyrant.
11:60: In this world and on the Day of Resurrection, a curse followed them. Take note, the people of Ad denied their Rabb. Take note, away with Ad, the people of Hud.
11:61: And to the people of Thamud We sent their brother Salih. He said: O my people, worship Allah. You have no deity other than Him. He created you from the earth and granted you life therein. So ask forgiveness of Him, then repent to Him. Indeed, my Rabb is near and responsive.
11:62: They said: O Salih, before this you were one in whom hope was placed among us. Do you forbid us from what our fathers worshipped? And indeed, we are in disquieting doubt about that to which you invite us.
11:63: He said: O my people, if I am upon a clear proof from my Rabb and He has granted me mercy from Himself, who would save me from Allah if I disobey Him? You would not increase me in anything except loss.
11:64: O my people, this is the she-camel of Allah, a sign for you; leave her to eat in Allah's earth, and do not touch her with evil.
11:65: Thereupon they hamstrung and felled her, then he said: Enjoy yourselves in your homeland for three days; this is a promise not to be belied.
11:66: When Our command came, We saved Salih and those who believed with him by a mercy from Us, and from the disgrace of that day.
11:67: A blast seized those who did wrong, and they became fallen on their knees in their homes.
11:68: As if they had never lived there. Know that the people of Thamud denied their Rabb. Know that away with Thamud.
11:69: And certainly Our messengers came to Abraham with glad tidings. They said: Peace. He too said: Peace. Before long he brought a roasted calf.
11:70: When he saw that their hands did not reach for it, he found them strange and felt a fear of them. They said: Do not fear, we have been sent to the people of Lot.
11:71: And Abraham's wife was standing and she laughed, so We gave her glad tidings of Isaac and after Isaac, Jacob.
11:72: She said: "Woe to me! Shall I give birth when I am an old woman and this, my husband, is an old man? Indeed, this is an astonishing thing."
11:73: They said: Do you wonder at the command of Allah? The mercy of Allah and His blessings be upon you, O people of the house! Indeed, He is Praiseworthy, Glorious.
11:74: When fear departed from Abraham and the glad tidings came to him, he began to argue with Us concerning the people of Lot.
11:75: Indeed, Abraham was very tender-hearted, very gentle-natured, and oft-turning.
11:76: Abraham turn away concerning it Behold that indeed it surely, truly comes command, matter rabb indeed I came punishment other, besides turned back
11:77: And when Our messengers came to Lot, he was troubled by them and felt distressed on account of them and said: This is a distressful day.
11:78: His people came running to him. And previously they had been committing evil deeds. He said: O my people, here are my daughters, they are purer for you. Fear Allah and do not disgrace me concerning my guests. Is there not among you a right-minded man?
11:79: They said: You have certainly known that we have no right to your daughters, and you surely know what we want.
11:80: He said: If only I had strength against you or could take refuge in a strong support.
11:81: They said: O Lut, indeed we are the messengers of your Rabb. They will never reach you. Set out with your family in a part of the night and let none of you look back, except your wife. Surely that which strikes them will also strike her. Surely their promised time is the morning. Is not the morning near?
11:82: When Our command came, We turned its top to its bottom and rained upon them stones of baked clay in heaps.
11:83: Marked in the presence of your Rabb, and it is not far from the wrongdoers.
11:84: And to Madyan, their brother Shuayb. He said: O my people! Worship Allah. You have no deity other than Him. Do not decrease the measure and the scale. Indeed, I see you in prosperity, and I fear for you the punishment of an encompassing day.
11:85: O my people! Give full measure and weight with justice, do not diminish people's things, and do not cause corruption in the earth as corruptors.
11:86: What Allah leaves is better for you, if you are believers. And I am not a guardian over you.
11:87: They said: O Shuayb! Does your salah command you that we should leave what our fathers worshipped, or that we should do what we wish with our wealth? Indeed, you are truly the forbearing, the rightly guided.
11:88: He said: O my people! Have you seen, if I am upon a clear evidence from my Rabb and He has provided me with a good provision from Him? I do not wish to act contrary to what I forbid you from. I only desire reform as much as I am able. My success is not but with Allah. Upon Him I rely, and to Him I return.
11:89: O my people, let not your opposition to me cause something similar to what struck the people of Noah or the people of Hud or the people of Salih to strike you. And the people of Lut are not far from you.
11:90: Ask forgiveness from your Rabb, then repent to Him; surely my Rabb is Most Merciful, Most Loving.
11:91: They said: O Shuayb! We do not understand much of what you say, and surely we see you as weak among us. Were it not for your close circle, we would certainly have stoned you, and you are not powerful against us.
11:92: He said: O my people! Is my close circle dearer to you than Allah, so that you put Him behind your backs? Surely my Rabb encompasses what you do.
11:93: O my people! Act according to your position; surely I am acting too. Soon you will know to whom a humiliating punishment comes and who is a liar.
11:94: When Our command came, We saved Shuayb and those who believed with him by a mercy from Us, and the blast seized those who did wrong, and they were in their homes fallen on their knees by morning.
11:95: As if they had never lived there. Know that just as Thamud was removed, Madyan was also removed.
11:96: And certainly, We sent Moses with Our signs and a clear authority.
11:97: To Pharaoh and his chiefs; but they followed Pharaoh's command, and Pharaoh's command was not on the right path.
11:98: He will precede his people on the Day of Resurrection and lead them to the Fire, and what an evil place of arrival is that place reached.
11:99: And they were made to follow a curse in this world and on the Day of Resurrection; what an evil gift is that given.
11:100: That is from the news of the townships that We relate to you; of them some are standing, and some are mown down.
11:101: We did not wrong them, but they wronged themselves. When your Rabb's command came, their deities whom they invoked other than Allah did not avail them in anything, and did not increase them in anything except loss.
11:102: And thus is the seizing of your Rabb when He seizes the cities while they are wronging. Surely His seizing is painful, severe.
11:103: Surely in that is a sign for those who fear the punishment of the Hereafter. That is a day on which mankind will be gathered, and that is a day to be witnessed.
11:104: And We do not delay it except until a numbered term.
11:105: When that Day comes, no soul shall speak except by His permission. Of them there will be the wretched and the happy.
11:106: As for those who are wretched, they are in the Fire; there will be for them groaning and gasping.
11:107: Abiding therein as long as the heavens and the earth endure, except what your Rabb wills. Surely your Rabb is the Doer of what He wills.
11:108: As for those who are happy, they are in Paradise, abiding eternally therein as long as the heavens and the earth endure, except what your Rabb wills, as an uninterrupted gift.
11:109: So do not be in doubt concerning what these people worship; they do not worship except as their fathers worshipped before.
11:110: And certainly, We gave Moses the Book, but differences arose concerning it. And were it not for a word that had preceded from your Rabb, judgment would have been made between them. And indeed, they are in disquieting doubt concerning it (the Book).
11:111: And surely your Rabb will pay all of them their deeds in full, for He is well-aware of what they do.
11:112: So be upright as you have been commanded, you and those who repented with you, and do not exceed the limits. Surely He is Seeing of what you do.
11:113: Do not incline toward those who do wrong, lest the Fire touch you, and you have no protectors besides Allah, then you will not be helped.
11:114: And establish salah at the two ends of the day and at the approaches of the night. Surely good deeds take away evil deeds. That is a reminder for those who take heed.
11:115: And be patient, for Allah does not let the reward of the doers of good be lost.
11:116: Why then were there not, from the generations before you, people of remnant who forbade corruption on the earth, except a few of those whom We saved from among them? And those who wronged followed what they had been pampered in, and they were criminals.
11:117: And your Rabb would not destroy the cities with injustice while their people were reformers.
11:118: And if your Rabb had willed, He would have made mankind one community, and they will continue to be in dispute.
11:119: Except those upon whom your Rabb had mercy, and for this He created them. And the word of your Rabb has been fulfilled: 'I will certainly fill Hell with jinn and humans all together.'
11:120: And all that We relate to you of the news of the messengers is that by which We make your heart firm. And in this has come to you the truth, and an admonition and a reminder for the believers.
11:121: And say to those who do not believe: 'Act according to your position, surely we are acting too.'
11:122: And wait, surely we are waiting.
11:123: And to Allah belongs the unseen of the heavens and the earth, and to Him the whole matter is returned; so worship Him and rely upon Him, and your Rabb is not unaware of what you do.
